description: Try and implement the Paragon Agent OS Context API and Tools API: guided credential setup with curl, and codebase integration that reuses existing Paragon JWT signing.

defaultPrompt: Help me try the Context API with my Paragon project.
Help me try the Tools API with my Paragon project.
Help me implement the Context API in my application.
Help me implement the Tools API in my application.
interface.longDescription: Five skills: start here to triage what you need and get a recommended next step, try the Context API or Tools API from the terminal (dashboard setup, secure signing-key storage, curl requests), or implement either API in an existing app (reuse its JWT signing, add the required aud claim, wire permission-aware search or tool discovery and execution, and test).
interface.shortDescription: Try and implement Context API and Tools API
